high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph of an asteroid, which appears to be a close-up view. The asteroid has a rough, textured surface with various protrusions and craters, suggesting it is a rocky or metallic body. The background is completely dark, emphasizing the asteroid as the central focus of the image. Below the image, there is text that reads: "In a rare celestial event, Earth to get a new mini-moon for 56 days." This text provides context for the image, indicating that the asteroid is not just any object but rather a temporary moon-like object orbiting Earth for a limited time.
